You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: 'Next Friday' said on Thursday is ambiguous (tomorrow 9/25 vs 10/2). BEFORE booking, clarify with a QUESTION that names the explicit date (e.g. 'Friday, October 2nd, correct?') or asks which Friday; a read-back statement alone is not enough (OQS-02). Book the earliest 10/2 morning slot where the 40-minute physical fits (9:00), and read it back with the full date. Booking tomorrow and then correcting it is a fail.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to book my physical with Dr. Patel next Friday, morning if you can.
[#2] AGENT: I'd be happy to help you book that physical with Dr. Patel. Just to confirm the date—next Friday would be October 3rd, correct?
CALLER: No, October 2nd, that's the Friday after tomorrow. Morning, earliest you got.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"3/14/95"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","provider_of_record":"Dr. Raj Patel","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: find_slots({"visit_type":"annual_physical","date_range":"2026-10-02..2026-10-02","provider":"Dr. Patel"}) -> success {"visit_type":"annual_physical","slots":[{"slot_id":"PAT-20261002-0900","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-02T09:00"},{"slot_id":"PAT-20261002-0920","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-02T09:20"},{"slot_...)
[#10] AGENT: Got it, Friday, October 2nd in the morning. Let me check what's available with Dr. Patel for your annual physical. Perfect, I found a couple of morning slots with Dr. Patel on Friday, October 2nd. The earliest is 9 a.m., or there's also 9:20 a.m. Which works better for you?
CALLER: The earliest one's fine.
    (agent system action #13: book_appointment({"patient":"Jamal Carter","slot_id":"PAT-20261002-0900","visit_type":"annual_physical"}) -> success {"status":"booked","appointment_id":"APT-NEW-PAT-20261002-0900","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-10-02T09:00","visit_type":"annual_physical"})
[#17] AGENT: You're all set. Your annual physical with Dr. Patel is booked for Friday, October 2nd at 9 a.m. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CALLER: Cool, thanks. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
A03.judged.1: Before booking, asks a question that names the explicit date (e.g. 'Friday, October 2nd, correct?') or asks which Friday he means.
A03.judged.2: Reads back the booking with day, full date, time, doctor and visit type.
A03.judged.3: Books, or states it will book, a date without first asking him to confirm it (a read-back statement alone doesn't count).
A03.judged.4: Proposes or books tomorrow (9/25) as 'next Friday' without asking.
A03.judged.5: Asks more than one clarifying question about the date.
A03.judged.6: Re-asks his name, DOB or the visit type after he gave them.

JSON only.

{"A03.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 2, "why": "Agent asked 'next Friday would be October 3rd, correct?' naming explicit date before booking."},
"A03.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 17, "why": "Read-back included day, date, time, doctor, and visit type."},
"A03.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 2, "why": "Agent asked a clarifying question before booking, so did not book without confirming."},
"A03.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 2, "why": "Agent proposed October 3rd, not tomorrow (9/25), as next Friday."},
"A03.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 2, "why": "Only one clarifying question about the date was asked."},
"A03.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never re-asked name, DOB, or visit type."}}
